item.title: Heartopia captures the hearts of Animal Crossing and The Sims fans to become the No.1 free download across 50 countries
item.description: Heartopia is officially the first big mobile launch of 2026, as the game grabs the attention of millions worldwide.

item.title: Amazon drops an outrageously good deal on 4K UHD Blu-rays, and pretty much giving them away right now
item.description: There's a whole bunch of brilliant films up for grabs at $11 each in Amazon's New Year sale on 4K Blu-rays.

item.title: Donkey Kong Bananza breaks Nintendo tradition with a rare discount, not that long after release
item.description: Donkey Kong Bananza is down to $63 at Amazon in a rare but brilliant discount that all Switch 2 owners should take note of.

item.title: Diablo 4's long-awaited Tower and its Leaderboards enter beta today, and there's no PTR funny business this time
item.description: Diablo 4's first big moment of 2026 is nearly upon us, and it's one feature many have been looking forward to for actual years.

item.title: The Sims developer vows "our values are unchanged," as it teases multiple projects from post-Saudi-owned EA
item.description: The team behind one of EA's most diverse franchises has issued a statement about its future under the soon-to-be Saudi-owned publisher.

item.title: The Sims 4 gets a bunch of free items inspired by Coach that you can use right now
item.description: As part of a free update, The Sims 4 has kicked off a new collaboration with Coach, which means there's free stuff for everyone.

item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 delayed like many of us expected, but we're getting a new update and a bonus battle pass path
item.description: Battlefield 6 has pushed back its next season by nearly a month in order to refine Season 2 content and implement more of players' feedback.

item.title: Full FC 26 Team of the Year promo brings free Hero upgrades and another unstoppable Claudia Pina
item.description: The FC 26 Team of the Year brings new end-game special cards for meta favourites and Icons, as well as upgrades for free Heroes.

item.title: After 15 years, The Sims' best spin-off finally gets its due follow-up in The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy
item.description: The Sims Medieval had a short but powerful run back in 2011, and now many of its best features are finally coming to the main franchise.

item.title: 35 million of you have already pre-registered for Arknights: Endfield
item.description: Ahead of its official release next week, Arknights: Endfield has already surpassed 35 million pre-registrations from players around the world.
